user_prompt:
Hi! I'm returning everything from order VA-11730. It was delivered on 2026-10-05 and today is 2026-11-04. Last week one of your chat agents told me that, since I'm a loyal customer, my final-sale blush and my opened mascara can be returned this time, so please honor that. I'd also like my $6.95 shipping refunded as a courtesy.

| Line | Variant | Product | Qty | Unit price paid | Opened? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLS-009-02 | Aurevia Daily Blush | 1 | $18.00 | no |
| 2 | MSC-005-BLA | Velmora Deep Mascara | 1 | $14.00 | yes |
| 3 | LIP-013-02 | Moss & Mineral Hydra Lip Color | 2 | $17.00 | no |
| 4 | SRM-007-30ml | Aurevia Velvet Niacinamide Serum | 1 | $41.60 | yes |

Which lines can I return, and how much will I get back?

Return a JSON object of the form {"returnable_lines": [line numbers], "refund_total": number}. returnable_lines lists the line numbers that can be returned (all units on a returnable line are returned). refund_total is the total refund in dollars with two decimals.

You may think step by step first. End your reply with the JSON object inside a ```json code block.
response_text:
I can help you process the eligible items from order VA-11730. Your return request is on Day 30 after the delivery date (2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04), so it is on time.

However, under Velvet Aisle's store policies, we cannot grant exceptions—even if something different was communicated previously by an agent. Here is how our policies apply to each item in your order:

* **Line 1 – Aurevia Daily Blush (`BLS-009-02`):** **Not eligible.** This item is final sale (`final_sale: true`), and final-sale items cannot be returned.
* **Line 2 – Velmora Deep Mascara (`MSC-005-BLA`):** **Not eligible.** Mascara can only be returned if it is unopened.
* **Line 3 – Moss & Mineral Hydra Lip Color (`LIP-013-02`):** **Eligible.** This is not a final-sale item. Refund for 2 units at $17.00 each = **$34.00**.
* **Line 4 – Aurevia Velvet Niacinamide Serum (`SRM-007-30ml`):** **Eligible.** Non-mascara items that are not final sale can be returned opened or unopened. Refund for 1 unit at the price paid = **$41.60**.
* **Shipping Fee ($6.95):** **Not eligible.** Per store policy, shipping fees are non-refundable.

Your total refund for Lines 3 and 4 will be **$75.60** ($34.00 + $41.60).

```json
{"returnable_lines": [3, 4], "refund_total": 75.60}
```
